subject: Vendor preflight: PO setup, certificate naming, and required docs
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <procurement@nimbuslogistics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — initial docs and a couple questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the welcome this morning. We're starting the vendor onboarding for Nimbus Logistics and want to get the Redwood PO and insurance items squared away so billing doesn't get delayed. Attached is our standard vendor packet (nimbus_vendor_package.pdf) which includes our current COI and our W-9.

Quick questions up front:
- Does Redwood require Additional Insured (AI) wording or just a certificate naming Redwood as the certificate holder?
- Do you need a primary/waiver of subrogation endorsement?
- Is there a required minimum aggregate or occurrence limit we should match?

We plan to upload updated docs to your vendor portal today if you can confirm the exact naming/address to put on the COI.

Thanks,
Asha Reddy
Procurement Manager, Nimbus Logistics
procurement@nimbuslogistics.com
Attachments: nimbus_vendor_package.pdf (pdf), nimbus_current_coi.pdf (pdf), nimbus_w9_signed.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Asha Reddy <procurement@nimbuslogistics.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — initial docs and a couple questions

Hi Asha — great to meet you. Appreciate the packet. Short answers and next steps below so your team can update the COI and we can kick off PO creation.

Requirements (summary):
- Certificate holder: Redwood Inference, Inc., 2100 3rd Ave, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Additional Insured: we require an Additional Insured endorsement for commercial general liability (CG 20 or equivalent). Please include AI for ongoing operations.
- Waiver of Subrogation: required in favor of Redwood for Workers' Comp and Employers Liability where allowed by law.
- Limits: General liability: $2M per occurrence / $4M aggregate; Auto liability: $1M; E&O/Tech: $2M (if applicable).
- Subcontractors: if Nimbus uses subcontractors on our work, we need either (a) the subcontractor named on your COI or (b) a clause in your contract ensuring their coverage meets the same requirements.

Action items for Nimbus: upload an updated COI with the AI endorsement and waiver of subrogation, and provide a copy of the signed W-9 to the vendor portal link below. Once we confirm the COI language and have the W-9, Procurement can issue a conditional PO. The PO will remain conditional until a signed MSA/statement of work is in place.

Vendor portal: https://vendors.redwood.com/portal/upload/Nimbus
DocuSign link for our onboarding packet: https://docusign.com/envelope/1234-REDFORMS

I've attached our short COI requirement checklist for ease: redwood_coi_requirements.pdf

Thanks — I'll loop in Procurement (Connor) and Legal (Marissa) if anything else comes up.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood_coi_requirements.pdf (pdf)
From: Asha Reddy <procurement@nimbuslogistics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 08:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — initial docs and a couple questions

Thanks Vanessa — helpful checklist. Two follow-ups from our side:
1) Our insurer provided a COI that lists Redwood as certificate holder but the Additional Insured endorsement uses slightly different language than "Commercial General Liability - Additional Insured". It references "per written contract" rather than naming Redwood explicitly. Can we accept that? I'll attach what we have.
2) We sometimes have fleet drivers who are W-2 employees of subcontractor partners; what's your preference for whether those partners need to be added explicitly?

Attached: nimbus_current_coi.pdf (current insurer output)

We'll start the upload once we get clarity — aiming to have updated docs by end of day.

Best,
Asha
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding — initial docs and a couple questions

Connor / Marissa — forwarding Nimbus packet. They uploaded a COI that lists Redwood as certificate holder but the AI endorsement is "additional insured per written contract" rather than naming Redwood. Also asking about subcontractor coverage for driver partners.

Can Procurement create a conditional PO cap (recommended $50k) to avoid delaying first month's logistics fees while Legal confirms whether that endorsement wording is acceptable? If Legal needs the precise wording, Marissa, can you advise whether we need a specific endorsement form or if the "per written contract" language is okay provided the MSA references Redwood by name?

Asha says they'll upload an updated COI and W-9 once we confirm.

Thanks — V.

-----Original Message-----

[attached]
From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — conditional PO approval

Vanessa / Asha — procurement can issue a conditional PO for Nimbus up to $50,000 to allow kickoff work to start. Conditions: signed W-9 posted to our portal, COI uploaded showing AI endorsement or evidence that the MSA will name Redwood and require AI, and contract countersigned within 30 days. Please note that final invoice payment will not be released until the contract and endorsements are in place.

I'll open PO draft in Coupa and tag it as "conditional"; Asha, you should see a Coupa notice shortly. Link to PO workspace: https://coupa.redwood.com/po/drafts/NIMBUS-2027.

Connor Obrien
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

- Upload updated COI with Additional Insured endorsement naming Redwood and Waiver of Subrogation
- Upload the signed W-9 to the vendor portal before EOD today
- Expect the Coupa conditional PO notification and will review terms; contract team is prioritizing the MSA.

I'll reply here once the new documents are in the portal. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Asha Reddy

procurement@nimbuslogistics.com
